title: Print Odd Numbers from 1 to N

content.problemStatement: Print all the Odd numbers from 1 to n.

solution.approach: Print all odd numbers from 1 to n separated by space.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Step by 2 starting from 1 (i.e. 1, 3, 5, ...) up to n.

hints: Increment by 2 in each step: i += 2.
